title: Acquire the Zendesk-style helpdesk vendor vs. build in-house
caption: Constraint mapping for the Q3 buy-vs-build decision; weights 1-5 reflect committee scoring, n=6 stakeholders.

spec.claim: Acquire HelpStack rather than build our own support platform in-house

pros.text: Live in 6 weeks instead of an 18-month build

children.text: SOC 2 and HIPAA controls already certified
Captures the Q4 enterprise renewal window

pros.text: Buys a 40-person team that already knows the domain

children.text: Tribal knowledge of ticket-routing edge cases

pros.text: Removes a competitor from the mid-market

children.text: Drains the cash reserved for two planned hires
Earn-out clause locks founders in for 24 months

cons.text: Their stack is a Rails monolith we must re-platform

children.text: No Kubernetes; runs on bare EC2

cons.text: Culture clash risks attrition of senior engineers

spec.decision: Proceed to a 30-day exclusive diligence period before committing; do not sign the LOI until the re-platform cost is bounded.

semantic_description.level_1_elemental: Two-column pro-con argument tree under one claim (acquire HelpStack vs. build in-house). Left column: 3 weighted pros; right column: 3 weighted cons; each top argument carries a 1-5 weight badge, and the heaviest item on each side expands into nested sub-points.
semantic_description.level_2_statistical: Pros sum to weight 12 (5+4+3); cons sum to weight 12 (5+4+3) - perfectly balanced totals. Each side has one weight-5 anchor (speed-to-market vs. the $210M price). 4 of 6 top arguments carry sub-branches; max nesting depth is 2.
semantic_description.level_3_perceptual: The visual tension is symmetric: the strongest pro (6-week launch) and strongest con (9x-revenue price) both score 5, so neither side dominates on weight alone. The con sub-branches cluster around money and re-platform cost, while pro sub-branches cluster around speed and certification - the decision turns on whether the re-platform risk can be bounded, which is exactly what the footer defers.
semantic_description.short_alt: Pro-con tree on acquiring HelpStack: 3 pros and 3 cons, both totaling weight 12; top pro (6-week launch) and top con ($210M price) both score 5.
